public interface SimpleDTS<S,I> extends SimpleTS<S,I>, InitialState<S>
A simple deterministic transition system. In a deterministic transition system, there exists in each state at most one successor state for each input symbol.

Implementation note: It is suggested to use a non-null type for the state class, as null will be used to denote an undefined successor. Allowing null to identify a state won't allow you to differentiate between a defined and undefined successor.
